instructions: patientsById has priority. All 10 supplied Oracle SMART test patients are mapped. The 14 V7 scenarios are assigned exactly once across the 10 Patient resource IDs. Four patients have two candidate scenarios and six have one fixed scenario. For a dual mapping, one candidate is selected per Oracle SMART authorization and remains stable for that authorization so browser refreshes/re-mounts cannot switch the episode mid-run. This is controlled demo routing, not a diagnosis inferred from Oracle data.
